scope: Keyboard access to human checks and a choice of capital-letter cues.

topics.title: Choose how capital letters sound
details: In Options, open Verbosity and find When encountering capital letters. Choose with a sound, with a higher pitch, with a lower pitch, or do nothing. Choose OK to save. The choice works across the app and stays after restart.
The cue applies when you type or read one letter at a time. It also applies to delayed letter names. Whole words and sentences keep their usual voice. Do nothing is the default.

topics.title: Use human checks with the keyboard
details: Press Enter or Space once on a check box, then wait. Holding the key no longer sends more clicks. Companion does not click again just because the site clears the box.

Use Tab and Shift+Tab to reach new challenge controls. Use the site’s accessibility option when offered. The site still decides whether you pass. PayPal’s live challenge has not yet been confirmed with this build.
